decisions.P1_env: build / pa / pairs: LADENV=reactot; loader (LadderData, load): env_d1fu2; frames: any pandas + pyarrow env
decisions.P2_adapter: build.py parse_rxn unchanged on the D1-HF run folders; hf_common.read_text tags texts, RE_FSPE proxy returns repr(E_new) for replaced frag{k}_rel outputs (one FSPE line, consumed once); RUNS / INPUTS rebound to the rung roots
decisions.P3_Pa: same call without replacement vs every labels_d1_hf(_g2) row: floats <= 1e-9 (coreh_* / n_attempts reported only), other columns equal, status ok
decisions.P4_H: unchanged rows = labels_d1_hf verbatim; replaced rows: d1 d2 barrier from the call, channels verbatim; Q-c / Q-b analogue checks
decisions.P5_dft_refs: refs_cr2.parquet (V14) after V_report all_pass + Q ready; own / Q / V e_hf checked
decisions.P6_g_refs: Q_keys keys; per key lowest rung HF e_frag{k}_rel_eh (refs_q.audit), no threshold; > 0.05 reported
decisions.P7_usable: token (sha256, glob = X182 row, n_atoms) + finite X182 row + 9 finite H
decisions.P8_universe: S_folds.csv = FU2 pairs.parquet (checked); P_r = both ends usable; P_01, P_012 intersections
decisions.P9_fu2: P_g1 == pairs.parquet rows with both ends in FU2 T_manifest, else STOP
decisions.P11_folds: FU2 T1 split json + pairs.parquet byte copies in $LAD/inputs/fu2_splits, checked vs S_folds masks
decisions.P12_loader: fu2.train.Data.__init__ unchanged under rung roots; y from label file; has_atoms = P_<rung>; SH glob + 9 H; dH in TARGETS order (c_ghost 0)
decisions.P13_labels: label_path argument, default F_pairs_cr2.csv; ids / ends = universe
decisions.P15_pathlog: audit-hook 'open' events + explicit parquet notes; check_paths by longest rung root
decisions.P16_f0: build dft exits 3 while F0_report stop is true unless --accept-f0-stop (after a user decision)
decisions.P17_g2: build g2 needs D1-G2 F_report / H_report complete, stop false, committed
decisions.P6b_graphs: g rungs: every reference geometry (frag{k}_rel input of its HF single point) = its Q-2 key's composition + WL bond-graph hash, isomorphic within the key, else STOP (spec Q-2)
decisions.P20_g2_keys: g2 rows in constrained (DFT-derived '|fixed:') keys -> STOP for a user decision unless --g2-q-keys
decisions.P21_g2_key_path: D1-G2 H_report outputs matched by repo-relative path
decisions.P22_currency: build accepted only with an unchanged fingerprint (stale -> exit 2); build STOP -> pairs exit 3
decisions.P23_l4_roots: FU2 T1 fold files / S_splits.json / V_report / Q_report shared; DFT-phase results dft; unknown paths fail check_paths

references.note: dft rung H uses the HF energy of the Q / V final reference (spec 4-1); HF can be higher than the row's own reference (HF and DFT orderings differ): n_hf_up

references.rule: Q_keys keys; per key lowest rung HF e_frag{k}_rel_eh (refs_q.audit), no threshold; > 0.05 reported

fu2_check.rule: P_g1 == pairs.parquet rows with both ends in FU2 T_manifest, else STOP
